quest.title: Tepetli Dissonance
quest.description: Within the Children of Echoes, Imix, from Muhuru's Gemporium, seems to have run into some major difficulties...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Mora x17050, Adventurer's Experience x8, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

chapter.num: A Prayer for Blessings, Told to Crested Peaks: Act I
chapter.title: Tepetli Dissonance

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: Sh—She's not back yet... I hope nothing bad happened to Master Cheven...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, that little kid is crying. Wonder what happened...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go check what's wrong.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello. Is something the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: *sobs* M—Master Cheven, she...

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: Sh—She went to gather Volcanic Crystals... But, she's still not back yet.

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: I told the guards, but they said that they don't have people to spare. Plus, that area's super dangerous, with tons of monsters and bad guys...

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: They have to finish making preparations before they can try to rescue her... But, it'll be too late by then!

choices.text: Don't worry, we'll look for her!

response.speaker: Imix
response.text: So, you'll help? Great! I'll just make a quick sketch to show you where the guards went earlier.

response.speaker: Imix
response.text: They said Master Cheven might have stopped around here.

response.speaker: Imix
response.text: She might have been forced to go near the Shadow Pin. If that's the case... Then... *sniffles*

response.speaker: Imix
response.text: Please! You have to save her!

choices.text: Guess it's time for more heroics.

dialogues.speaker: Imix
dialogues.text: Please help me save Master Cheven!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why did she stop?

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: ...Because of her daughter. Poor Nechca contracted an awful illness and Tlazolli put everything aside to take care of her.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: Even as Nechca's illness grew worse, Tlazolli never gave up. Like a torch in the night, she was determined to burn bright, even as darkness encroached from all directions...

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: Still, all's well that ends well! Thanks to the doctor's medicine and the Great Spirit's protection, Nechca's flame was rekindled!

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: Her condition has been slowly improving ever since. She's still weak, of course, and has to recuperate at home... but she's well enough to write letters already.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: She often writes to Xilonen, apparently. Her dream is to become an Ancient Names forger, just like her mother.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: Her birthday's in a few days, so Tlazolli asked me to find a pure Volcanic Crystal to give her as a present.

choices.text: So that's why you were out here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, talk about an important chunk of ore! What a nice gift! Paimon hopes it helps her feel better!

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: I'm sure she and her mother appreciate your well wishes.

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: Alright, let's head back. I'm sure Imix is worried sick.

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: Actually, why don't you come with me to visit Tlazolli tomorrow?

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: It's all thanks to you that I managed to bring back the crystal.

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: You deserve a reward for helping us protect something so significant.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I just hope it makes Nechca happy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right. A good mood makes for a quick recovery!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And of course, we, uh... wouldn't say no to a little gift...

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: Haha, don't worry. Something tells me you'll like this one.

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: But, I'll let Tlazolli tell you what it is herself.

choices.text: No wonder you wouldn't leave the crystal behind.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, they didn't put up much of a fight...

choices.text: Guess they knew what they were up against.

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: Phew... Thank you so much... I thought I wasn't gonna make it down this mountain alive.

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: #Saved by {NICKNAME}... Guess my luck's not too bad today.

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: Ah, sorry, let me introduce myself. I'm Cheven, a gem artisan. I'm not usually this lucky, but maybe things are looking up.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Imix sent us to help.

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: She did, huh... *sigh* I didn't mean to make her worry. I wasn't planning to be gone longer than two days tops.

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: But, then, I discovered a new seam of Volcanic Crystal near the Shadow Pin... It's a large deposit, and the purity is exceptional.

response.speaker: Cheven
response.text: I dug up a whole bunch of it and was getting ready to head back, but the phlogiston within the crystals attracted monsters...

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: I panicked, and ran up a narrow path to avoid them... But, by the time I was in the clear, I ended up running into those bandits... You showed up in the nick of time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If the situation was so dangerous, why didn't you just drop the crystals and run?

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: I left most of them behind, believe me. I only kept the purest chunk — I have to bring it back, no matter what.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: ...For Tlazolli, and poor little Nechca.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are they?

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: Ah, right, you wouldn't know. Tlazolli is a former Ancient Name artisan, and Nechca is her daughter.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: Anyway... I'm sure you've seen the state this place is in. It's all because the Shadow Pin suddenly came crashing to the ground and left behind a massive crater.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: The seam I found was closer to the outside, so it survived the disaster. Still, the crash riled up the monsters in the area, and now they're everywhere.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We don't need anything fancy like that. A normal gift is more than enough.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So... She crafts Ancient Names?

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: That's right... Or, well, she used to. Now, she just handles regular forging commissions.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Xilonen's in that line of business too.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: Oh, you know Xilonen? Haha, try mentioning that name in front of Tlazolli. She could sing Xilonen's praises forever.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: "The foremost expert in Ancient Names" "the future of our tribe," "the finest artisan in Natlan"... You'll never hear the end of it.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: I know Tlazolli misses the days when she used to forge Ancient Names. She'd never say as much... but I can tell.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: According to the map, we should be getting close.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Let's search the area. Stay on your toes, though, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Cheven
dialogues.text: ...Get away from me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look over there! Is that Master Cheven?
